note: Post-run normalization required by scripts/ci/pre-push-security.sh (hardcoded-home rule): the two raw GitHub Actions log excerpts contained the runner account's generic home path (/home/<gha-runner>/work/..., where <gha-runner> is GitHub's default Actions runner user name), which the gate treats like an account path. After the run, that token was replaced with /home/user/ in the two artifacts and corpus.json's artifact digests were updated. protocol.json is frozen and still records the pre-normalization digests the model actually saw; reports/claude-sonnet.json records the same pre-normalization digests in input_digests_before/after and per-call prompt_sha256. To reproduce from this tree, restore the token in the two artifacts (replace /home/user/work/ with /home/<gha-runner>/work/ using GitHub's default runner user name) so the frozen digests match again. No prediction, score, or label changed.
